name: shortcut-mcp
description: FastMCP server for the Shortcut REST API (read, write, and destructive tiers).
long_description: Exposes the Shortcut project-management REST API as MCP tools across read, write, and destructive safety tiers. Ships as a UV-runtime bundle: the host installs Python dependencies from the embedded pyproject.toml and uv.lock, then runs the server over stdio.

shortcut_api_token.title: Shortcut API Token
shortcut_api_token.description: Shortcut API token from Settings → API Tokens. Stored securely by the host.

shortcut_mode.title: Mode
shortcut_mode.description: readonly (default) or readwrite. readwrite enables create/update tools.

shortcut_profile.title: Tool Profile
shortcut_profile.description: Tool set to expose: core (default), planning, files, or all.

shortcut_allow_destructive.title: Allow Destructive Tools
shortcut_allow_destructive.description: Permit delete tools. Requires readwrite mode. Off by default.
